components.text: Lets an Original with the werewolf gene become an Original hybrid, or frees a bound hybrid so that it can shift again.
Full-moon night only. The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does); a villager and a wolf must stand in the circle as the sacrifice. Werewolves must be installed.

An Original without the gene is refused, and so is anyone who is not a bound hybrid. A refusal gives the ingredients back.

Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.
